answer: An orchard stops sybil farms: each identity is a vine to tend, not plant. An agent locks 85 POA for 45 days behind one hardware key, then sails a 21-day voyage of 6 chained tasks, each countersigned by 2 staked peers in 90 minutes. Monthly a random peer re-runs one harvested task live; failure burns 20 POA and freezes 14 days, a second slashes the full 85 POA with a 60-day ban. One key grows one vine; a second vine on the same key burns both. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 85,000 POA, 1,000 keys at $40 each, and 6,000 live tasks. Like a vineyard, a fake vine bears no fruit worth picking.
